```{r doc-code, include=FALSE}
source("../code/R/doc_code.R")
```

All panels are produced by
[`script/Figure7.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/Figure7.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

Panels **7e-7g** show sample-to-sample variability of effector gene expression
within a single cluster (Il4 in CD4.T, Il17a in CD4.X, Ifng in CD4.Q). They
require a pseudobulk matrix computed per sample rather than per cluster, which
is not part of the deposited dataset, and are not reproduced here.

## Setup

```{r fig7-setup, code=code_for("../script/Figure7.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) Effector gene expression heatmap {#fig7a}

```{r fig7a-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure7.R", "7a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig7a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure7/7a_heatmap_effector_genes.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 7A.** Heatmap of curated effector gene expression across immgenT
clusters (log1p CP10K): the 59-gene curated list, less the five genes that
never reach 0.5 log1p CP10K in any cluster. Rows (genes) and columns (clusters)
are ordered by hierarchical clustering. Annotation bars indicate lineage and
activation status (resting versus activated). Effector genes group into modules
that are reused across lineages rather than partitioning by lineage.
:::

## (B-D) Individual effector cytokines {#fig7bd}

```{r fig7bd-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure7.R", "7b-7d"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig7bd-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure7/7b_barplot_Il4.png",
                          "assets/Figure7/7c_barplot_Il17a.png",
                          "assets/Figure7/7d_barplot_Ifng.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 7B-D.** Bar plots showing average expression of Il4 (B), Il17a (C) and
Ifng (D) across immgenT clusters, coloured by lineage. Each cytokine is
conventionally assigned to a single T-helper subset; each is instead produced
by clusters drawn from several lineages.
:::
